Sandbox_AshboroCigaretteVending_GasSpawn: Percent chance used when a matching gas station location is detected.
Sandbox_AshboroCigaretteVending_Convenie: Percent chance used when a matching convenience store location is detected.

Sandbox_AshboroCigaretteVending_StoreSpa: Percent chance used when a matching store location is detected.
